name: Date range picker
summary: Pick a start and end day from two months side by side, or one quick range such as last 7 days, then apply it to a report.
use: for filtering a report or table by dates
a11y: Every day is a button with its full date as its label and aria-pressed on the start and end; today has aria-current, future days are disabled, and the range length is announced in a polite live region.
